PR91 CI run 41923862017 passes all nine jobs at 83be8497. Comparing its prebuilt-path APK to the one-environment source-only proof finds exactly two differing entry contents: libapp_lib.so (embedded compiler source paths differ) and libsherpa-onnx-c-api.so (build API/NDK and source paths differ). The remaining 1721 entries match. The current build-alignment pass wires pinned source Sherpa into CI/release, selects Rust 1.98.1 and normalizes Rust/C/C++ source paths. Two fresh same-checkout APKs match (SHA256 64ebe81dffa99db60ae9a16cb1ad96599359fe187798524dfc9037750354a1f0); a clean Sherpa rebuild matches its receipt. The initial full relocated-checkout comparison failed with different bundled Pagefind 1.4.0 index bytes. A controlled relocated rebuild with identical frontend/native inputs produces the identical APK, isolating the observed mismatch to index generation. Upstream Pagefind review completed without dependency changes: 1.5.2 and 1.6.0 CLI builds still vary with file creation order; 1.6.0 includes upstream PR1124. Sorted sequential ingestion through the existing 1.4.0 Node API passes eight fresh-process runs for both the real starter corpus and a controlled multilingual/diacritics/filter fixture. The owner-approved implementation now uses sorted sequential sourcePath ingestion with locked Pagefind 1.4.0. A fresh relocated native rebuild also exposed an ELF build-ID mismatch from symbol/debug metadata removed after linking; shared-library link-time stripping now preserves a reproducible build ID. Two fresh original-checkout APKs and one fresh relocated APK match byte-for-byte: SHA256 4cf48620c35f6949030525178b79574a0c5c611668e930d94f2a06472d161c20, all 1723 entries and all frontend hashes match. Both source recipes produce Sherpa SHA256 3936e1f978f0294ef488f2494dcb95cd19f81d9191912753a21bf7c5ba825fb8. This is one host/toolchain with shared dependency/toolchain homes and reused verified source/archive inputs, not an independent CI/F-Droid or production-signature proof. Pagefind root MIT license is unchanged; no new transitive license clearance is implied. CI run41964028402 passes all nine jobs at b151cc5f. Its supplied APK differs from the unstamped local reference only in libapp_lib.so because transfer diagnostics embeds GITHUB_SHA, set to PR merge a5f4d82d6dd6b993a0dee376ee70fcd9540cd10c in CI and absent locally. Both commits have tree d8ed83c41ecc94b552c216298b6f8dff7db6ea30. A local diagnostic rebuild changing only that environment value reproduces the CI APK byte-for-byte, SHA256 99132381fc7e3eacd848554027ddc811284517a8a665dd2e5200b90f7d8cae23. This is a cross-host match with aligned revision-stamp input, not another clean two-build or fdroidserver/signature proof. The approved next pass implements a shared productionBuildRevision resolver and project-owned PAPERCUT_BUILD_REVISION: full checkout HEAD, validated matching overrides, required explicit metadata for exports without .git, and no inherited GitHub or parent-repository identity. Android/F-Droid, desktop and iOS wrappers all supply it; direct developer builds can leave the optional diagnostic value null. Tests cover Git worktrees/exports/invalid values and every packaging caller; full frontend tests (785 passed, one existing skip), frontend build and shipping Rust suite (332 passed, nine existing ignores) pass. Two fresh Git-checkout APKs and one no-Git source-export APK match byte-for-byte with project revision ef16d94ca266457fb2d9e72fdbc9b40144a957db despite different ambient GitHub stamps: SHA256 2e81c7678e0152a7fa3ae08cbd8003282e6ebf77a59990079b5a57e9adac26a6, all 1723 entries and frontend hashes match. They are uncommitted review working-tree candidates using that checkout base, shared host/toolchains/dependency homes and unchanged verified native inputs; not published releases or clean source-commit evidence. Committing updates the diagnostic revision and APK hash. Committed implementation eb56a893 passes all nine jobs in CI41987142956. Artifact13397468619 was downloaded directly and its ZIP digest verified. A fresh local Rust/Gradle build of actual CI merge fed3a37d0f5be9be6ee2595002bdd694cfe821b4 derives its project revision automatically and matches the complete CI APK: SHA256 2cf33d0acdd9c4c05a069eb03ed96c13c630e9195bc04d4c699effcce470a752, all1723 entries identical. Shared dependency/toolchain homes and verified native inputs were reused locally; CI native bytes match. Actual fdroidserver reproduction, production signature copying and scanner/build review remain pending. That CI verification pass identified the draft ndk:r29 mismatch. The subsequent fdroidRecipePreflight records exact-pin installation/resolution, the numeric metadata fix and remaining scanner/buildserver gates; production toolchain unchanged.
